device.name: RIGOL DP832A triple-channel DC power supply

facts.text: The class is a control interface for the RIGOL DP832A power supply over USB TMC
command() opens the device file, writes the command plus a newline, waits 50 ms and closes the file
query() writes the command plus a newline, waits 100 ms, reads up to 4096 bytes and strips the reply
output_on() sends :OUTP CH{channel},ON, output_off() sends :OUTP CH{channel},OFF, and get_output() reads :OUTP? CH{channel} and compares the reply with ON
set_voltage() writes :SOUR{channel}:VOLT and get_voltage_setpoint() reads :SOUR{channel}:VOLT?; measure_voltage() reads :MEAS:VOLT? CH{channel}
set_current() writes :SOUR{channel}:CURR and get_current_setpoint() reads :SOUR{channel}:CURR?; measure_current() reads :MEAS:CURR? CH{channel}
set_ovp() writes :OUTP:OVP:VAL CH{channel},{voltage} and enables :OUTP:OVP CH{channel},ON; set_ocp() does the same with :OUTP:OCP:VAL and :OUTP:OCP
status() returns one ChannelStatus with output, voltage_set, current_set, voltage, current and power
all_off() turns the outputs of channels 1, 2 and 3 off
configure() sets the voltage, then the current, then optionally turns the output on
The REPL prints the status of channels 1, 2 and 3

operator_required.reason: the clone states no voltage or current range for the DP832A: its numeric command lines interpolate the caller's value (rigol.py:77, 90), and the clone has no README or other text manual; the site supplies the range of the installed unit from its nameplate
